about: S62's last drawing (v2: a dropped sword standing upright, point down in the shallows at the water's edge, its owner walked away) for the S63 match cut to the starship on its pad. Written by the GOLD agent from video/src/scenes/chorus2.js (S62.sword, S62.final, s62cam) over P53 take 2.

frame.units: x as a fraction of frame width, y and lengths as fractions of frame height (y down)

angle_note: the blade's axis in screen coordinates (-90 = vertical). The sword stands point DOWN (hilt up, the point in the mud); S63 reads only the axis, so the ship starts upright at the same place and size and settles onto its pad by the next kick

waterline.what: where the blade enters the water and mud

look: a broad straight blade, steel-grey with a dark central fuller, a bronze guard, a dark wrapped grip and a round bronze pommel, standing in red shallow water with its reflection below; low golden backlight from frame right, golden clouds behind
motion_into_cut: static: the sword never moves; the camera eases in (zoom 1.0 -> 1.075) and settles by 214.85, so the last ~0.45 s hold still
portrait_note: 4:5 / 9:16 use the same frame-centre composition (the camera centres the sword at x = .5 with the same vertical placement and length in every aspect)
